notes: K7 kickboxing client card (VALD machine tests only, no manual tests). Strength: shoulder ER and IR (punch drive and the brakes on every punch) plus hip abduction and adduction (kicking, checking, stance). Symmetry uses the hip tests only, on the approved lower-body scale in machine_card_v1.json. Mobility: shoulder arc of motion and weight-bearing dorsiflexion (mobility_tests_by_sport.kickboxing). Neck strength, trunk rotation and the jump are shown on the report, not scored.
